title: Parkite Condo #20 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Upon arrival, you’ll enter through the underground garage with a designated parking space, and an elevator will whisk you up to the condo’s second-floor entrance. Inside, the split floor plan reveals a stunning great room, where hardwood floors and expansive windows create an open and inviting atmosphere. The living room is a sanctuary of comfort with contemporary furnishings, a 65-inch Smart TV, a cozy gas fireplace, and access to a private patio. The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, boasting high-end stainless-steel appliances, a SubZero refrigerator, a Wolf gas stovetop, and a wine fridge. The central island provides bar seating for four, perfect for casual meals or entertaining, while the dining area offers a lovely wood table with seating for eight, making it an ideal space for memorable gatherings. Park City Parkite offers an exquisite retreat in the heart of Historic Main Street, delivering a perfect blend of modern elegance and mountain charm. This luxurious condo places you steps away from world-class dining, boutique shopping, vibrant nightlife, and more, all while providing easy access to Park City Town Lift via a free Trolley ride or a quick bus trip to Deer Valley Resort. Designed for those who appreciate the finer things, this single-level residence features two master bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, and ample space to comfortably accommodate up to six guests.

Features: One assigned parking space in communal underground garage.
